nodes.title: Release 12 integration (int/r4-rel12 on base 0b8dc83): T-server claude/r4-latency c4f156a, T-client claude/r4-content 62e3716 (with its main.tsx + rrweb 2.1.7 patch-request), T-voice claude/r4-duplex c58dc40 (with its cascadeLink/LessonScreen patch-request); shared/trace.ts conflict resolved to T-server's version (its only change adds kinds). Release 13 (4A d348414, the RCA fixes) ships after release 12 on its own gate

md.measurements:
- `ms-r12-tvoice-owner-lessons-voice-2026-10-11` (T-voice, 2026-10-11). Method: read-only, from main's RCA export of the owner's two c9 lessons (docs/design/round4/build/r12/rca/owner-lessons-2026-10-11.json).
  - Both lessons ran the cascade lane.
  - 16 of 17 child turns were spoken, and 0 of those 16 carry asr_conf: the live transcriber returns no logprobs (server/voice/stt.js).
  - The talk mix marked 8 of 17 turns 'unclear'.
  - No row records the talk mode (tap vs hands-free), so why the owner had to tap could not be read from the database. The cause was found separately: ms-r4-owner-cohort-wrong-email.
md.decisions:
- `dc-r12-integration` (2026-10-11): release 12 was merged in this order on base 0b8dc83: T-server first (it owns shared/trace.ts), then T-client, then T-voice.
  - The only conflict was shared/trace.ts. T-server's later version adds kinds (studio.slot.refused, job.start/end, play.act, tts.first/end/failed), so it was taken whole.
  - The patch-request commits on the client branches (src/main.tsx installTrace, package.json rrweb 2.1.7 as a lazy tier-2 chunk, src/lesson/cascadeLink.ts and LessonScreen.tsx voice hooks) came in with their merges.
  - Release 13 (4A's RCA fixes, claude/r4-conversation d348414) shares server/brain/turn.js and server/studio/seam.js with the recorder's hooks. It ships after release 12 on its own gate, so the recorder is live while the owner tests the fixes.
  - Reverse if: the release 12 gate or the packaged batteries fail on a recorder hook. Then drop that stream's merge, because the recorder must never change a lesson.
